catalog.name: browser-bug-reproduction

catalog.name: calendar-coordination

catalog.name: daily-briefing

catalog.name: decision-archaeology
catalog.description: Reconstruct why a technical, product, or design choice was made from code, history, and notes, and explain what matters before reversing it. Use for inherited behavior, puzzling constraints, and disputed rationale; use ordinary code explanation or defect review when historical intent is not the question.

catalog.name: demo-director

Use for walkthroughs, launch demos, and explainers that must show proof; not a trim-only video edit or a request to invent product capabilities.

catalog.name: generative-series
catalog.description: Create and curate a coherent visual series from generative rules, reproducible inputs, and deliberate variation. Use for families of prints, covers, tiles, or algorithmic artworks; not a single reference-led composition or a concept lesson.

catalog.name: github-review
catalog.description: Review a specified GitHub pull request at its current head, inspect the diff and surrounding context, and prepare actionable findings with check status. Use for PR review; reviewing does not authorize comments, approval, pushes, or merging.

catalog.name: gmail-draft-reply
catalog.description: Compose, save, revise, or send a scoped Gmail reply as requested, preserving its thread, recipients, sender identity, and attachments. Use for message composition and reply completion, not inbox classification or labeling.

catalog.name: gmail-triage
catalog.description: Review a bounded Gmail inbox or search result, identify actionable messages, and apply explicitly requested organization. Use for mail triage and labeling; summarizing mail does not authorize sending, deleting, or changing inbox settings.

catalog.name: google-docs-update
catalog.description: Make a bounded Google Docs content or formatting change in the correct tab and section, preserving unrelated material and verifying the saved revision. Use for document edits, not Sheets cells, document sharing, or exporting files.

catalog.name: google-sheets-update
catalog.description: Update or append specified Google Sheets cells or rows through available document tools or an authorized browser, preserving formulas and checking saved results. Use for bounded sheet data edits, not workbook redesign or broad data analysis.

catalog.name: idea-pressure-test
catalog.description: Pressure-test a product or creative project idea with a fair case, contrary evidence, and a cheap test with decision criteria. Use for deciding whether an uncertain idea deserves more work; skip straightforward edits and requests to build an already chosen design.

catalog.name: learn-by-making
catalog.description: Learn an unfamiliar idea by building a small working artifact, making predictions, and using observed results to repair the mental model. Use for hands-on understanding with a concrete learning goal, not a task the user simply wants completed.

catalog.name: product-shortlist
catalog.description: Compare current product or used-item offers in exact configurations using total cost, condition, and buyer constraints. Use for shopping research and listing comparison; it does not contact sellers, bid, reserve, or purchase.

catalog.name: rabbit-hole
catalog.description: Investigate a puzzling claim, trend, or story by tracing sources, testing rival explanations, and producing a readable account of what changed your understanding. Use for an open question worth digging into, not a quick lookup or a dossier on a private person.

catalog.name: recurring-monitor
catalog.description: Set up or check a recurring watch with clear alert rules, saved observations, and an available host scheduler. Use for ongoing monitoring, not a one-time lookup.

catalog.name: reference-remix
catalog.description: Turn visual references and a brief into distinct original art direction and a usable visual artifact. Use for reference synthesis, moodboards that need a decision, and artwork or design driven by several influences; not a routine edit inside an already settled visual system.

catalog.name: session-to-skill
catalog.description: Extract a reusable decision from authorized work, then improve existing guidance or create a focused skill when the evidence warrants it. Use for deliberate workflow capture and skill authoring, not raw history export, automatic memory, installation or publication.

catalog.name: story-mining
catalog.description: Find an evidence-backed angle in interviews, transcripts, research notes, or rough drafts and turn it into a finished piece that preserves the speaker's voice. Use when the story is buried in source material; not punctuation-only editing or a request to summarize every source evenly.

catalog.name: travel-reservation
catalog.description: Prepare or complete an explicitly requested travel booking, change, or cancellation while tracking exact travelers, total price, terms, payment, and reservation status. Use for reservation lifecycle work, not a generic shopping shortlist.

catalog.name: unstick-project
catalog.description: Recover progress on a stalled project by separating the intended outcome from the blocked approach and completing a small useful next artifact or experiment. Use when attempts keep circling a dependency or constraint; not a settled edit, a root-cause debugging request, or permission to bypass a real access boundary.

catalog.name: web-form-update
catalog.description: Change specified profile, settings, or form values and verify persistence, including autosave and validation behavior. Use for bounded record edits; purchases, reservations, and outgoing messages need their specific workflow.

catalog.name: web-research
catalog.description: Answer bounded factual questions, check which sources apply, and compare options using current public evidence or supplied source bundles. Use for facts, status and evidence-based comparisons; an open investigation testing rival explanations belongs to rabbit-hole.

catalog.name: web-task-execution
catalog.description: Operate a requested website task or recover browser access using the correct account and tab context, then verify the result. Use for general browser handling when a more specific workflow does not fit; public-source research alone is excluded.
